title: An affine neighbourhood injects into a stalk on a locally Noetherian scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] and $x\in X$. There exists an affine open neighbourhood $V\subseteq X$ of $x$ [def-pc-scheme] for which the germ homomorphism $\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_X)\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is injective [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk].
